title: Amma Ammaayiyamma
desc: Prabhavathy, one of five children, marries a rich businessman, Shekharankutty, and forgets about her family. Her husband decides to make her understand the importance of her family.

title: Saguni
desc: Kamal fights corruption to save his family's legacy, challenging politicians and bureaucrats for justice and redemption.

title: Aathi
desc: A young boy moves to Chennai for his education where he meets a girl and falls in love with her. Soon, they learn that they are both on a mission to avenge the death of their parents.

title: Masterpiece
desc: When the students of the Travancore Maharaja College start to form gangs and engage in crime and brutal fights, Edward Livingston, an English professor decides to restore order in the campus.

title: Ushiran
desc: Murugavel, a police officer, learns that his younger brother is a petty criminal working for a local gangster. When he tries to bring about a positive change in him, the brother tries to kill him.
